description: Desired settings for the nuget.org Trusted Publishing form; this file is not an API request and does not register or activate the policy.
workflowRequirements: Use the NuGet profile username of the policy creator when requesting a temporary API key; the package owner can differ.
Grant id-token: write to the publishing job in the reusable workflow and to the calling job.
Exchange a GitHub OIDC token with audience https://www.nuget.org for a temporary key shortly before publication.
Supply that temporary key to the existing NuGet push command instead of the long-lived NUGET_API_KEY secret.
Preserve the production environment and exact main-source release gates.
